title: 20th Century Boys: The Resurrection
alt: A stadium full of people under a deep blue sky, in low sunlight from the right. In the middle of its pale floor is a hill of white flowers as high as a house. At the top of the hill, on a bed of white flowers, is a sign in dark red flowers: a hand that points up, with an eye in it, inside the outline of an eye. Long rods of clear crystal go out from behind the hill like the rays of a sun. A black coffin with a purple lining stands upright in the flowers, open and empty. In front of it, on a way of dark polished stone, stands a small man in a grey suit and a red tie, with his hands open. A white cloth covers his whole head, and the same sign is on it. His shade goes up two white steps at the left. White petals lie on the stone.
summary: A painting of the resurrection of Friend from 20th Century Boys in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is the first day of the Expo of 2015 in 20th Century Boys, a manga by Naoki Urasawa. Friend is the man in the mask who made himself the savior of the world. He is dead, and his coffin stands in a hill of flowers in the stadium.

The Pope has come to pray for him. Then the dead man gets up and stands in front of his coffin. The sign over the flowers and on his mask was the mark of a secret club of small boys. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
